sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Steelers: Week 6 Initial Injury Report
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers returned to the practice field Wednesday as they prepare for Sunday’s Week 6 matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers at Raymond James Stadium. Tampa Bay’s initial injury report featured five players who did not participate in practice, including quarterback Baker Mayfield (right thumb), safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib), running back Sean Tucker […]
